evidence.moatW: FY2025(5月期)10-K 収益認識注記『total revenue disaggregated by operating segment』(全社 $10,340,181千): Uniform Rental and Facility Services $7,976,073千=77.1% / First Aid and Safety Services $1,218,090千=11.8% / Fire Protection Services $817,463千=7.9% / Uniform Direct Sales $328,555千=3.2%（%は会社自身が同表に開示した実数）。→ ≥売上15%の事業は Uniform Rental の1本のみ（第2位 First Aid 11.8% は15%未達）＝『2本』の85は不成立。50の発動条件も両方とも不成立: (a)1製品≥80% → 最大の Uniform Rental 77.1%は80%未満、かつ同区分は単一製品ではなく 10-K Item1の定義どおり『the rental and servicing of uniforms and other garments, including flame resistant clothing, mats, mops and shop towels and other ancillary items ... restroom cleaning services and supplies and the sale of items from our catalogs』の複合で、製品レベルの売上は原本非開示（≥70%の単一製品を示す開示が無い）。(b)最大顧客≥20% → Item1『We provide our products and services to over one million businesses of all types ... no individual customer accounting for greater than one percent of Cintas' total revenue』＝最大顧客<1%。→ 堀は『ルート密度』1本（約12,100本の配送ルート・478稼働拠点・12配送センターの同一網に4区分すべてが乗る）だが、用途(制服/難燃衣料/マット/モップ/洗面所/救急安全/防火)と顧客(100万社超・最大<1%)が高度に分散＝70。留意1: セグメント単位の77.1%は70の目安『最大製品<70%』を上回るが、これは製品ではなく複数製品の束であり、製品レベルで≥70%を示す開示は原本に無い。留意2: 地域はItem1『our U.S. operations, which generated over 90% of its consolidated revenue in all periods presented』＝米国集中で、分散しているのは用途と顧客の二軸。出典: SEC 10-K CIK0000723254 acc 0000723254-25-000017 (FY2025-05-31) 収益の分解表・Item1 Customers/Operations and Distribution/Government Laws and Regulations

nulls.dom: 2026-07-29 堀再監査で空欄化(旧dom=70)。FY2025(5月期)10-K Item1『Competition』は全文が『The primary markets served by each of the Cintas operating segments are local in nature and highly fragmented. Cintas competes with national, regional and local providers, large national retailers and small local retailers as well as companies with a significant online presence and the level of competition varies at each of Cintas' local operations.』——自社シェア%も上位N社合計シェア%も一切開示していない。10-K全文の『market share』は Item1A『If existing or future competitors seek to gain or retain market share by reducing prices, Cintas may be required to lower prices』のリスク文言のみで自社の数値ではない。唯一の順位表現は Item7『We are North America's leading provider of corporate identity uniforms through rental and sales programs』＝v9.9.38但し書きの『leading provider はシェアの証拠ではない』に該当。→ 刻みを導く数値が原本に無いため空欄。【方向の注記】原本が自ら市場を『local in nature and highly fragmented』と述べており、これは寡占(70)を支持しない。数値が出れば70より50側に落ちる公算が高い＝旧70は原本無根拠の上振れ。出典: SEC 10-K CIK0000723254 acc 0000723254-25-000017 (FY2025-05-31) Item1 Competition/Customers, Item1A, Item7
